facts.statement: Tenant reported on 19/05/2024 that the oven does not heat on any oven or grill setting; light and sound still work; appliance replaced the previous year.
Property is Flat 2, 176 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ8 5ZZ; tenant of record Leo Bennett.
Landlord (Felix) asked that the contractor who fitted the oven be contacted for a charge-free warranty service.
Harbour Services fitted the oven (agency record) and were instructed on this job on 21/05/2024.
Harbour Services attended, could not repair the oven, and initially reported the 12-month warranty had just expired.
On 12/06/2024 the contractor reported the oven is covered by a 2-year manufacturer's warranty; the manufacturer's engineer attended, ordered parts, and returned.
On 21/06/2024 the contractor confirmed the oven repair was completed under warranty with no charge to the landlord; agency recorded the task completed without payment.
At the contractor's follow-up call on 21/06 the occupant said the oven appeared fixed but had not yet been fully tested.
No landlord standing spend cap is on file in this case record; no spend was incurred, so no cap rule was engaged.
